about: The Queen of Lanka and wife of Ravana in the Ramayana.
Short form of Vallavarayan Vanthiyathevan in Ponniyin Selvan.
The master archer and middle brother of the Pandavas in Mahabharata.
The Vanara King and ally of Rama in the Ramayana.
The King of the Devas, appearing in all three major epics.
The boat woman known as Samudhra Kumari in Ponniyin Selvan.
The narrator of the Kurukshetra war in the Mahabharata.
The 'Oomai Rani' and mother of Nandini in Ponniyin Selvan.
The son of Vali and a mighty warrior in the Ramayana.
The Moon God; also the name of Shakuni's father in Mahabharata.
The beautiful and vengeful Queen of Pazhuvoor in Ponniyin Selvan.
The wise Chola princess in Ponniyin Selvan.
A common and revered name for Lord Krishna in the Mahabharata.
The tragic hero and eldest son of Kunti in the Mahabharata.
Rama's loyal brother in Ramayana; also the ancestor of the Kurus.
A name for Rama, meaning descendant of King Raghu in the Ramayana.
The Kodumbalur princess in Ponniyin Selvan.
The wise prime minister and voice of dharma in the Mahabharata.
Sendhan Amuthan, the humble friend in Ponniyin Selvan.
The legendary Tamil poet who wrote the Kamba Ramayanam.
The primary Pandya conspirator in Ponniyin Selvan.
The biological father of Lord Krishna in the Mahabharata.
The elder brother of Jatayu, the eagle king in the Ramayana.
The Kuru King and father of Bhishma in the Mahabharata.
A name associated with Parthivendra Varman in Ponniyin Selvan.
The group of five brothers in the Mahabharata.
The Sambuvarayar chieftain family in Ponniyin Selvan.
The hundred brothers who fought the Pandavas in the Mahabharata.
The grand patriarch of the Kuru dynasty.
The truthful one, an epithet used in the epics.
The Prince of Matsya and son of King Virata.
The teacher of the Asuras in the Mahabharata.
A powerful sage who appears in the Mahabharata.
Often used for Dharma-puthiran (Yudhishthira).
The maid who influenced Queen Kaikeyi in the Ramayana.
The King of Ayodhya and father of Rama.
The divine messenger sage who travels between worlds.
Referring to Akshaya Kumara, Ravana's son in the Ramayana.
Referring to the Kodumbalur chieftain in Ponniyin Selvan.
The wife of Sage Vashistha in the Ramayana.
The sage husband of Ahalya in the Ramayana.
The domain of the Pazhuvettarayar clan in Ponniyin Selvan.
Short for Parthivendhran, the Pallava prince in Ponniyin Selvan.
The king who brought the Ganges to Earth.
The kind demoness in the Ramayana.
